ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a central atom labeled Si. Si is connected to two F atoms above, and also connected to left and right R groups; in the lower right there is also a separate negatively charged fluoride ion, labeled F and a negative sign. Curved arrows are also drawn in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Then reason: It is necessary to write only the chemical species in the figure. The two R groups are represented by the wildcard * in SMILES according to the problem method, so the central silicon fragment is *[Si](*)(F)F. The separate fluoride ion is written as [F-]. Two unconnected species are separated by a dot, so the complete SMILES is *[Si](*)(F)F.[F-].

method.method_draft: First identify only the chemical species in the image, excluding the arrow: a central Si bonded to R, R, F, and F, plus a separate fluoride anion. Convert each R group to a wildcard '*' and write the tetravalent silicon fragment as '*[Si](*)(F)F'. Then append the disconnected fluoride anion with a dot separator, giving '*[Si](*)(F)F.[F-]'.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有一个中心原子标为 Si。Si 与上方两个 F 相连，并且与左、右两个 R 基团相连；右下方还有一个单独的带负电的氟离子，标作 F 和负号。图中还画有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。再推理：需要只写出图中的化学物种。两个 R 基团在 SMILES 中按题目方法用通配符 * 表示，因此中心硅片段为 *[Si](*)(F)F。单独的氟离子写作 [F-]。两个不相连的物种之间用点号分隔，所以完整 SMILES 为 *[Si](*)(F)F.[F-]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawing as a silicon center labeled Si bonded to four substituents: two fluorine atoms (F) at the top left and top right, and two generic R groups at left and right. Also read a separate fluoride anion labeled F with a circled minus charge near the lower right. Ignore the curved reaction arrow as instructed.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that asks for the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and explicitly says to ignore the arrows.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: generic/unknown R substituents can be represented by wildcard atoms '*'; silicon is written in brackets as [Si] when explicitly specified with substituents; neutral fluorine substituents are 'F'; a separate charged fluoride ion is '[F-]'; disconnected components are separated by '.'.
